findings.description: San Francisco Fire Department hazmat units and fire companies responded to the Presidio Golf & Concordia Club on the afternoon of Friday 4 September 2026 while crews worked to identify a hazardous material inside the clubhouse. The club lists its address as 8 Presidio Terrace, which is the club's own parcel on the site — the assessor classes it Clubs, Lodges, Fraternal Organizations — so the address is genuine and not a false hit. SFist's Day Around the Bay column of 5 September carried the same incident.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Hazmat Crews Swarm Historic Presidio Golf & Concordia Club Over Chemical Scare,” 6 September 2026

publish.note: Fails the ten-year test, and the evidence bar with it. Nothing is established to have happened to the building: the material was never identified, no damage, evacuation or outcome is reported, and the piece is assembled from one fire-department social post — it says in its own words that the available account did not report the scene signage and the available information did not identify the club's relationship to the Presidio. An unresolved same-day emergency response is a news blip, not a fact for a timeline that runs a century deep. If the material or the damage is later reported, that story is the one to carry.
